command:
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=20 LLM-T1-NC80 bash -lc '
set -e
export TERMINATE_CMD="az ml compute stop --name LLM-T1-NC80 --workspace-name brainpowa-northeurope --resource-group rezolve-AI"
export IDLE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS=3600
export POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=60
export IDLE_UTIL_PERCENT=5
export GRACE_SECONDS=600
export WATCHDOG_LOG=/var/log/arf_idle_watchdog.log
sudo touch $WATCHDOG_LOG && sudo chmod 666 $WATCHDOG_LOG || touch $WATCHDOG_LOG
nohup env TERMINATE_CMD="$TERMINATE_CMD" IDLE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS=$IDLE_THRESHOLD_SECONDS POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS=$POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS IDLE_UTIL_PERCENT=$IDLE_UTIL_PERCENT GRACE_SECONDS=$GRACE_SECONDS WATCHDOG_LOG=$WATCHDOG_LOG bash /opt/arf/idle_watchdog.sh >> $WATCHDOG_LOG 2>&1 &
disown
sleep 2
echo WATCHDOG_PID_CHECK
ps aux | grep idle_watchdog | grep -v grep
'
